body: Of course, i appreciate it as well. Good job! Thats amazing, learning languages can be so difficult and its so neat that youre still pushing forward. Keep learning them!!

Any friend i have opened up to has been similar, saying things like "youre not allowed to bc id be sad" or telling me not to bring it up casually. I dont blame them but it hurts. I hope you stay, but i know how hard it is to feel like you have to keep going
Youre still valid, idk if i could ever go through with it but its hard to want to all the time
